prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Chunk into Vault of Heroes (between Leth Nurae and Dakhnarg), and hit Planar Gateway. Follow the path south from the Altar until you see a wooden watchtower on your right - here's your first victims. If you time the wanderers right, they will be nicely bunched into 3x3 groups. From here, walk directly West until you meet the larger Gnoll Slave Camp. It has sufficient spawns to keep 1 sorcerer, or 5-6 other class soloers occupied >;-). Note the guard groups patrolling the camp perimeter - nice targets. Once you get inside, you'll quickly be able to identify victim groups.

Once inside leth Nurae, hang a right and follow the dirt path, enter the building and head down the steps hidden door clicky on the right, head down and 2 ae victims in first room, then head around the corner to a hallway that is free from agro, through those doors is a group of 3 mobs you can ae, and down the steps in same room is another group of 3 mobs, I alternate between spawn points, great way to earn xp.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Go straight through a few rooms, you come to another hallway with a portal on the end. Say the password and it drops you on a platform surrounded by mobs, out of agro range but in pull range. You can do these then work your way around the outer ring and maybe down the stairs. Many duo, triple pulls. If you get in trouble run to the inner platform and say the PW, and lose agro instantly. You can go there before 12, but you wont have fireball. Great zone for the noob aoe'er.
